Business Leaders

hero.description: Business Leaders Association is a pre-professional organization at the University of California San Diego committed to creating an open and accessible community where students can grow professionally through meaningful connections, collaborative learning, and shared ambition.

about.title: Our Mission
about.body: Business Leaders Association is committed to creating an open and accessible community where students can grow professionally through meaningful connections, collaborative learning, and shared ambition. By connecting students with peers, alumni, and industry professionals, we empower individuals to explore their interests, broaden their horizons, and take initiative in their own professional journeys. We believe professional growth starts with exposure, curiosity, and the willingness to put yourself out there, regardless of prior experience or background.

options.title: General Membership
options.description: Free to join — no fees required.

items.question: When is recruitment?
items.answer: Twice a year! In the beginning of Fall quarter and the beginning of Winter quarter.

items.question: How to apply?
items.answer: Check out our linktree to find applications and requirements to apply!

items.question: Is BLA just a business club?
items.answer: Not at all! BLA is open to all majors and all backgrounds.

items.question: Do I need previous experience to join?
items.answer: Nope! BLA is beginner friendly, and especially good to explore options if you're still figuring out what you want to do.
